answer: The cheapest real defence: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because harbor only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, prism is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any terrace approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
